reason: Two registered v1 publication attempts completed audit and staged-bundle validation but Windows returned WinError 32 when atomically renaming a Dropbox reparse-point directory. Both final outputs remained absent and both empty partial directories were removed.

transport_contract.staging: write three uniquely named staging files inside the final output directory and fsync each file
transport_contract.precommit_validation: recompute assessment, Markdown, identity, and hashes from staged bytes
transport_contract.completion_marker: audit_identity.json is installed last; absence means incomplete publication
transport_contract.atomic_unit: each file is atomically replaced within one directory; no directory rename is attempted
transport_contract.postcommit_validation: the frozen v1 validate_published_bundle must pass on the exact three-file final directory
transport_contract.failure_cleanup: remove the completion marker first, then only transport-owned staging/final files and the newly created output directory; preserve the original exception

claim_boundary: Transport v2 changes only how the already registered append-only audit bundle is published under Dropbox on Windows. It cannot change, recompute under different rules, or broaden any scientific result, stationarity qualification, FACETS boundary, R boundary, or v1 audit conclusion.
